date_note: 1News (25 November) says RNZ staff lost access to systems on Wednesday morning, 25 November.
geo_basis: the report names New Zealand's public broadcaster RNZ without a city; pin at the country's capital
title: RNZ says it is investigating what it understands to be a cyber breach, 1News reports
summary: 1News reports that RNZ is investigating what a spokesperson called "what we understand at this stage to be a cyber breach". RNZ staff lost access to Wi-Fi, editorial systems or the VPN on Wednesday; RNZ told SecurityBrief it contained unusual activity in one system. The NZ Herald reports an RNZ spokeswoman said RNZ "is continuing to manage a cyber incident" that has affected some systems, with some disruption to publishing and broadcasting of pre-recorded audio.
plain: RNZ says it is still managing a cyber incident that has affected some of its systems. The NZ Herald reports some pre-recorded audio publishing and broadcasting was disrupted, and Concert FM staff used CDs.
exec: RNZ says it is managing a cyber incident affecting some systems, with some disruption to publishing and broadcasting of pre-recorded audio, the NZ Herald reports.

sources.name: SecurityBrief New Zealand: RNZ investigating potential cyber breach

validation.note: Corroborated by 1News, SecurityBrief New Zealand and the NZ Herald (RNZ spokesperson statements); RNZ own page was not read.

review.note: Compared title, Wednesday 25 Nov date, spokesperson quotes, contained activity, NCSC notified against 1News and SecurityBrief
